name: Bush seepweed
desc: Bush seepweed (Suaeda nigra): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Suaeda nigra, often still known by the former name Suaeda moquinii, is a species of flowering plant in the amaranth family, known by the vernacular names bush seepweed or Mojave sea-blite.
